authority: IDs, names and roles from original project cast; visual identities authored for this wave, owner review pending

characters.name: Cassia of the Lighthouse
characters.visual_identity: Adult woman about 28, warm brown skin, long angular face, dark almond eyes, black hair braided in a low coiled bun, single loose temple curl. Chalk linen tunic with narrow mineral-blue shoulder stripe and small plain bronze collar. Precise, observant lamp-keeper; no jewellery except a small plain blue cloth tie.

characters.name: Brennic the Red
characters.visual_identity: Adult man about 32, pale freckled skin, broad square face, thick straight reddish brows, short rough red hair and short red stubble. Muscular neck, weathered terracotta tunic with a dark red shoulder patch, plain bronze collar. Proud former auxiliary, forceful but human.

characters.name: Garran Stonehand
characters.visual_identity: Adult man about 44, weathered medium tan skin, broad rounded face, large nose, deep-set kind brown eyes, thick dark-brown beard with a grey streak at chin, cropped wavy brown hair. Heavy flax tunic with dull ochre shoulder seam and plain bronze collar. Patient farmer and father, strong neck, no armour.

characters.name: Iskar Windborn
characters.visual_identity: Adult man about 27, warm tawny skin, high wide cheekbones, narrow dark eyes, long black hair tied in a short low knot with shaved temples, thin moustache. Pale flax tunic with muted sage shoulder wrap and plain bronze collar. Restless defiant steppe rider; no hat.

characters.name: Elder Sadruba
characters.visual_identity: Older woman about 58, deep brown skin, strong long jaw, short tightly curled grey hair, a thin healed scar down left eyebrow, deep-set eyes and powerful neck. Terracotta red wool wrap over chalk tunic, plain bronze collar. Commanding arena elder; no crown or modern clothing.

characters.name: Elder Ophel
characters.visual_identity: Older man about 63, olive skin, long narrow face, receding short silver hair, small pointed silver beard, tired hooded dark eyes and arched eyebrows. Mineral-blue robe with simple chalk border, plain bronze collar. Dry scholar and debt keeper; no spectacles or hat.

characters.name: Elder Ruadh
characters.visual_identity: Older woman about 61, ruddy light skin, broad soft face, deep smile lines, thick grey braid laid over one shoulder, broad straight nose. Dull ochre wool shawl over linen and plain bronze collar. Patient steady tent elder, flour dust at shoulder, no decorative jewellery.

characters.name: Elder Kesh
characters.visual_identity: Older man about 66, tawny brown skin, weathered narrow face, grey-black moustache and long divided chin beard, bald crown with grey hair tied behind. Muted sage scarf across one shoulder over chalk tunic, plain bronze collar. Amused trader, asymmetric brows and a small pale healed cheek scar.

characters.name: Corvo
characters.visual_identity: Adult man about 25, light olive skin, compact triangular face, hooked nose, very short black curls, clean shaven, one notched eyebrow. Faded red sleeveless tunic and plain bronze collar. Boastful rival with tense jaw, no mask, no hood, no borrowed character costume.

characters.name: Nysa
characters.visual_identity: Adult woman about 26, medium olive skin, round heart-shaped face, full dark eyebrows, wide dark eyes, dark wavy hair held by a narrow blue cloth band with a single braid over shoulder. Mineral-blue tunic, plain bronze collar. Socially warm bargaining rival, small dimple, no cosmetics or gems.

characters.name: Senna
characters.visual_identity: Adult woman about 29, dark brown skin, square athletic face, short natural coiled hair, level brows, broad nose, small healed chin scar. Ochre linen shoulder wrap and plain bronze collar. Proud formal fighter, upright posture, no helmet.

characters.name: Lio
characters.visual_identity: Adult man about 23, tan freckled skin, long lean face, uneven curly chestnut hair, wide smile and a small gap between front teeth, clean shaven. Sage-edged chalk tunic and plain bronze collar. Reckless likeable gambler, energetic brows, no hat.

characters.name: Fenna
characters.visual_identity: Adult woman about 22, pale olive skin, narrow pointed face, dark tired eyes, messy short black hair tucked behind one ear. Patched flax tunic with tiny faded sage thread repair and plain bronze collar. Wary clever displaced camp member; no glamor or childish proportions.

characters.name: Old Quill
characters.visual_identity: Elderly man about 74, sun-browned skin, thin deeply lined face, sparse white hair standing in wisps, untrimmed white beard, one drooping eyelid. Frayed chalk robe stained with earth pigment and plain bronze collar. Wry secretive scholar, alert eyes, no wizard hat.

characters.name: Warden Septima
characters.visual_identity: Adult woman about 47, deep olive skin, long stern symmetrical face, black hair pulled tightly into a bun with one silver streak, dark steady eyes. Chalk-white mantle with salt-grey angular edging and a small square bronze clasp; NO prisoner collar. Ritual warden, restrained authority, no crown.

characters.name: Lanista Aulus Venno
characters.visual_identity: Adult man about 51, fair warm skin, broad heavy face, receding closely waved dark hair, clean shaven, fleshy nose and smiling eyes. Cream Roman draped wool with narrow muted terracotta stripe and small bronze clasp; NO prisoner collar. Genial calculating games broker, no laurel crown, no jewellery display.
